steps.title: Mince Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Place the tissue chunk onto a cell culture plate on ice and mince using disposable scalpels.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL lysis buffer (6 M GdmCl, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM CAA, 100 mM Tris pH 8.5) to the minced tissue and transfer to a Matrix D tube with ceramic beads.

substeps.instruction: Beat the tissue using FastPrep-24™ at 4.5 M/S for 40 seconds at 4 °C, repeated 2 times.

steps.title: Sample Clarification and Sonication
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample for 5 minutes at 7000 x g on ice and transfer to a new tube.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate the sample on ice at 40% for 20 seconds.
Sonicate the sample on ice at 60% for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Heat Denaturation
steps.instruction: Heat the sample for 5 minutes at 95 °C, vortexing every 1 minute.

steps.title: Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 12000 x g for 5 minutes, 10 minutes, and 10 minutes respectively, collecting the supernatant at each step.

steps.title: Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Remove 5 µL of the sample and dilute it to measure protein concentration using a BCA kit.

steps.title: Lys-C Digestion
steps.instruction: Take 100 µg - 300 µg of the sample for two-step enzymatic digestion using 25 mM Tris pH 8.5 as the dilution buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 3x volume of dilution buffer to the original lysate.

steps.title: Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Perform trypsin digestion on the Lys-C digested sample.

substeps.instruction: Add an additional 6x volume of dilution buffer to the original lysate volume (total 9x dilution of original sample volume).

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store digested samples at -80 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Column Conditioning

steps.title: Sample Desalting
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to 1% (v/v) TFA and load onto the desalting column.

substeps.instruction: Wash the sample 3 times with 200 µL of 0.1% (v/v) acetic acid.
Elute peptides with 150 µL of 40% (v/v) acetonitrile with 0.1% (v/v) acetic acid.
Elute peptides with 150 µL of 80% (v/v) acetonitrile with 0.1% (v/v) acetic acid.

steps.title: TMT Labeling
steps.instruction: Resuspend the sample in 100 mM TEAB pH 8.5 and add the assigned TMT tag.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the sample with the TMT tag for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Sample Pooling and Analysis
steps.instruction: Mix each set of 10 samples together in equal amounts.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pooled sample with 200 mM ammonium formate.
